status: Closed — quote contamination repair and discoverable scope audit/status surface verified through ATM-GOV-0259
area: Task scope amendment / Windows CLI parsing
finding: On Windows/PowerShell, `tasks scope add --add "path1,path2"` normalized the live allowedFiles list but persisted quote-contaminated paths in amendmentHistory, leaving audit history with entries like `"packages/...` and `...test.ts"`.
expectedBehavior: Scope amendment parsing should canonicalize paths once and persist the same clean path list to allowedFiles and amendmentHistory. The CLI should reject or repair malformed quoted path fragments and expose a supported status/preflight command for scope audit.
evidenceOrRepro: The original quote-contamination reproduction is covered by the current parser and governance tests. `node --strip-types tests/cli/write-ticket-scope-amendment.test.ts` exited 0 and persisted quote-free paths/events; `node --strip-types tests/cli/scope-amendment-work-admission-ticket.test.ts` exited 0 on 2026-09-06. The parser now canonicalizes the quoted CSV before both live scope and amendment history are written.
followUp: Closed after verifying ATM-GOV-0259 is done, tasks scope and tasks audit are discoverable, normalized allowed files and immutable amendment history are exposed, and the focused parser/admission tests pass. No successor task is required for this finding.
